def test_flip_case():
    # Basic mixed case
    assert flip_case("Hello") == "hELLO"
    assert flip_case("Python") == "pYTHON"

    # Already swapped
    assert flip_case("hELLO") == "Hello"

    # All lowercase
    assert flip_case("abc") == "ABC"

    # All uppercase
    assert flip_case("ABC") == "abc"

    # Empty string
    assert flip_case("") == ""

    # No letters (digits, symbols, spaces)
    assert flip_case("12345!@# ") == "12345!@# "

    # Mixed with numbers and punctuation
    assert flip_case("PyThOn 3.12!") == "pYtHoN 3.12!"

    # Single character
    assert flip_case("a") == "A"
    assert flip_case("Z") == "z"

    # Unicode letters
    assert flip_case("ÑoÑo") == "ñOñO"

    # Palindromic swap (input equals output)
    assert flip_case("aBcDe") == "AbCdE"

    # Double application returns original
    s = "RandomString123"
    assert flip_case(flip_case(s)) == s

    # Non-ASCII mixed
    assert flip_case("Grüße") == "gRÜßE"

def test_flip_case():
    # Basic mixed case
    assert flip_case("Hello") == "hELLO"
    assert flip_case("hElLo") == "HeLlO"

    # All lowercase -> all uppercase
    assert flip_case("hello") == "HELLO"

    # All uppercase -> all lowercase
    assert flip_case("WORLD") == "world"

    # Empty string
    assert flip_case("") == ""

    # Single character
    assert flip_case("a") == "A"
    assert flip_case("A") == "a"

    # Non-alphabetic characters unchanged
    assert flip_case("Hello, World! 123") == "hELLO, wORLD! 123"
    assert flip_case("!@#$%") == "!@#$%"

    # Unicode characters
    assert flip_case("ñÁç") == "ÑáÇ"

    # Already-swapped string returns original (involution)
    s = "PyThOn 3.9"
    assert flip_case(flip_case(s)) == s

    # Whitespace preserved
    assert flip_case("a b\tc\nd") == "A B\tC\nD"

    print("All tests passed!")


test_flip_case()
